solutions.title: BFS over reachable amounts
solutions.strategy: Treat each coin addition as an edge and search by coin count levels until the amount is reached.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each reachable amount can expand up to c coin denominations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Visited amounts and the queue are bounded by amount + 1 states.

solutions.title: Bottom-up minimum coins DP
solutions.strategy: Build the best coin count for every amount from 1 through the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: For each amount, every denomination can be tested.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table stores one minimum count for each amount.
